name: Ur'kyo
summary: In Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits, Ur'kyo guides priests in the ways of shadow and light. The Darkspear regard him as their spiritual leader and greatest priest, and he teaches their traditions in the Horde capital.

sections.title: Spiritual Master of the Darkspear
sections.body: Ur'kyo guides Darkspear mystics and visiting practitioners from the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar. After fleeing the Echo Isles, the Darkspear made a home in Durotar alongside Thrall's Horde. Their sacred traditions remain vital to the tribe, and Ur'kyo keeps those ancestral practices alive through his teaching.

sections.title: Guidance and Ancient Rites
sections.body: Priests who come to Ur'kyo find a patient instructor in faith and old rites. He teaches the Hex of Weakness and the defensive ward called Shadowguard. Horde priests also turn to him to learn about the coalition's varied spiritual ways, from troll voodoo and ancestral customs to foreign disciplines.

faq.answer: Ur'kyo trains priests in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits. The Darkspear regard him as their spiritual leader and greatest priest.
Ur'kyo is in the Valley of Spirits, the troll district on Orgrimmar's western side. Look for him in the training huts near the water, alongside other spiritual mentors.
Ur'kyo teaches priests foundational spells of shadow and light. He also guides Darkspear priests in the Hex of Weakness and Shadowguard.

faq.q: Why does Ur'kyo practice in Orgrimmar rather than the Echo Isles?
faq.answer: After Zalazane's betrayal and the loss of the Echo Isles, the Darkspear resettled with the orcs in Durotar. Ur'kyo teaches the tribe's mystical traditions and trains new defenders for the Horde from the Valley of Spirits.

faq.q: Does Ur'kyo interact with non-troll priests?
faq.answer: Yes. Ur'kyo teaches visiting Horde priests, sharing Darkspear knowledge with other members of the Horde, including the Forsaken.

faq.q: What is Ur'kyo's role among the Darkspear priests?
faq.answer: The Darkspear recognize Ur'kyo as their greatest priest and foremost spiritual leader. He passes ancestral customs, rites, and voodoo practices to the next generation.

angles.text: As a Horde priest traveling through Durotar, you can learn the ways of faith, shadow rites, and sacred wards from Ur'kyo.
As a Darkspear troll, you can look to Ur'kyo as your foremost spiritual guide in Orgrimmar. He preserves your tribe's voodoo and ancient magical rites after the loss of the Echo Isles.
As a member of the Horde, you can find Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits, teaching healers and shadowcasters who prepare to defend the Horde.
